briefing: Every ship in the solar system flies the same way: slowly, and a little bit lost.
Nobody has charted the path, and nobody has left a light on.
Your ship is the {shipName}, and your job is to fly out past the last planet, placing a beacon at every stop so the ships behind you can follow.
Earth already has a beacon. It just needs someone to switch it on.
preflightLine: Hull, check. Blaster, check. Pilot... that's you.
beaconFlavor: Every map starts with a home.
